text: わたしは　いつも　きみが　そこを　とおるのを　みてたが　やっと　あう　ことが　できた！

structure.jp: きみが　そこを　とおるのを
やっと　あう　ことが　できた！
structure.en: at last I was able to meet you!

patterns.name: 〜ことができる
patterns.span: あう　ことが　できた
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by ことができる says that someone is able to do it. あう ことが できた = 'I was able to meet you'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing, so it can be what is watched. きみが そこを とおるのを みてた = 'I watched you pass by there'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action keeps going on; みてた is the short spoken form of みていた. みてた = 'was watching'.
